item.title: Write an Article, Then a Shorts… A 60-Year-Old Reporter’s New Routine [Dureundureun AI ⑰] (기사 하나 쓰고, 쇼츠도 한 편…60대 기자의 새로운 루틴 [두런두런 AI ⑰])
item.description:
This is a story from about a decade ago, when remote work was still unfamiliar. At 8 a.m., almost every day at the same time, there was someone who commuted to the Hankyoreh newspaper newsroom and opened a laptop. That person was reporter Kwak Nopil. After finishing his term as department head in 2013, at the age of 51, he chose to return to the path of a field reporter. He didn’t major in science in college, wasn’t in a natural sciences track, and had never experienced reporting on science beats. Yet, drawn by “curiosity,” he entered the path of a science reporter. For 14 years now, he’s maintained a routine of arriving earlier than others to study, present topics, and write articles. After all… nothing beats consistency. His science and future articles have become quintessential content representing the Hankyoreh newspaper. <<> These days, Reporter Kwak has started something new. He creates and uploads Shorts videos on his YouTube channel, “Kwak Nopil’s Future Window,” based on articles he writes daily. The trigger came around the Lunar New Year when he met a friend who runs a publishing house. When that friend, who uses AI to create book promotional materials, casually said, “You should give it a try,” Reporter Kwak plunged into studying Shorts. His teacher was Gemini. The tool Gemini recommended was the AI video editor VREW. VREW allows adjusting the aspect ratio, making both long-form and short-form videos possible; when you input a script, the AI adds a voiceover and suggests images, videos, and background music that fit the content, creating a draft. The user then selects and modifies these to complete the video. Starting February 18 with “Pivotal Moments That Changed Humanity’s View of the Universe,” Reporter Kwak used VREW to create and upload 130 Shorts videos by the end of July, nearly one per day excluding holidays. <<> Reporter Kwak uses the Lite plan, costing 14,900 won per month. He says the 2,000 credits provided monthly are enough to create about 20 Shorts. However, credit usage varies depending on how much AI images, videos, and voice functions are used. The user interface (UI) is intuitive and convenient to use; when he briefly summarizes an article for a script and inputs it, VREW adeptly finds matching images, which he found impressive. Reporter Lee Joohyun also followed Reporter Kwak’s lead and started using VREW. <<> What Reporter Kwak needs are the script text, images and videos for the article, and a voice. He uses VREW’s “AI My Voice” feature. After recording 30 sentences for 5–10 minutes in a quiet place once, from then on, just inputting a script allows an AI voice resembling his own to read the sentences. Of course, he can also choose and use various other voices instead of his own. <<> Initially, he used images automatically generated by VREW or photos inserted into his articles, but this gradually evolved. Reporter Kwak describes incorporating video files as an “upgrade moment.” He explained that he uses four tools to insert video files into Shorts. <<> △VIDEO DOWNLOAD HELPER A web browser extension to download videos from general websites except YouTube.
△SSSTWITTER.COM A website to download Twitter videos.
△4K DOWNLOADER A free program to download YouTube videos.
△CLIP CHAMP To delete unnecessary parts from a video. <<> However, just because a video is downloaded online doesn’t mean it can be freely reused. Reporter Kwak checks the original creator’s terms of use, ensures it falls within the scope of citation for reporting purposes, and uses it accordingly. He also credits the source in the video or description. <<> It takes Reporter Kwak about an hour to create and edit one Shorts video. After filing his article each morning, he creates a Shorts video from that article. He also needs to write the article to be submitted the next morning in advance. It’s like an extra task added to his existing article work. When asked why he makes Shorts videos as purely extra work, Reporter Kwak replied, “It’s just, well, fun… I’ll probably keep at it for about a year.” <<> For Reporter Kwak, AI is more of a “tool that lets him do things he couldn’t do before” than a “tool that reduces his workload.” AI broadens the horizon of work, but it also increases the amount of work and working hours—that seems accurate. <<> Reporter Kwak’s article ‘Chinese Rocket Struck by Lightning’, which recorded 150,000 page views (PV) on Naver, was also reborn as a Shorts video. Check it out on the YouTube channel “Kwak Nopil’s Future Window.” In the next “Dureundureun AI,” Reporter Lee Joohyun will visit you with a Shorts video she created herself. See you soon. <<> Lee Joohyun, Reporter, Hankyoreh People and Digital Research Institute edigna@hani.co.kr (재택근무가 아직 낯설던 10여년 전 얘기입니다. 아침 8시. 거의 매일 같은 시각에 출근해 한겨레 신문사 편집국에서 노트북을 여는 사람이 있었습니다. 곽노필 기자였습니다. 그는 국장직을 마친 2013년, 쉰한 살에 다시 현장 기자의 길을 택했습니다. 대학에서 과학을 전공하지도 않았고, 이과도 아니고, 과학 분야 출입처를 경험한 적도 없었지요. 다만 “호기심”에 이끌려 과학 기자의 길에 들어섰죠. 남들보다 일찍 출근해 공부하고, 발제하고, 기사를 쓰는 생활이 올해로 14년째입니다. 역시… 꾸준함을 이기는 건 없더라고요. 그가 쓰는 과학·미래 기사는 한겨레신문을 대표하는 독보적인 콘텐츠로 자리를 잡았습니다.)

item.title: "Violated Price Fixing Ban"... Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Revokes Korea Laying Hen Association's Corporate Charter (“가격 결정 금지 어겼다”…농식품부, 대한산란계협회 법인 허가 취소)
item.description:
The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs announced on the 29th that it has revoked the approval for the establishment of the Korea Laying Hen Association as a nonprofit corporation. This decision was based on the judgment that the association violated the conditions of its establishment approval and infringed upon the public interest, including being sanctioned by the Fair Trade Commission for alleged egg price collusion. (농림축산식품부가 대한산란계협회의 비영리법인 설립 허가를 취소했다고 29일 밝혔다. 협회가 계란가격 담합  혐의로 공정거래위원회 제재를 받는 등 설립 허가 조건을 위반하고 공익을 침해했다는 판단에서다.)

According to the Ministry's explanation on that day, when it approved the association's establishment as a nonprofit corporation in January 2023, it imposed conditions under the rules for the establishment and supervision of nonprofit corporations, requiring compliance with the Fair Trade Act and prohibiting the determination and notification of farm-gate egg prices. (농식품부 설명을 이날 들어보면, 농식품부는 지난 2023년 1월 협회의 비영리법인 설립을 허가하면서 비영리법인 설립·감독 관련 규칙에 따라 공정거래법을 준수하고 계란 산지가격을 결정·통지하는 행위를 하지 않을 것을 조건으로 부여했다.)

However, the association was found to have repeatedly determined farm-gate egg prices and notified business operators up to January 21 of this year. The association set standard egg prices by weight every Wednesday and notified them via text or fax, upon which farmers based their farm-gate prices. (하지만 협회는 올해 1월21일까지 수시로 계란 산지가격을 결정하고 사업자들에게 통지한 것으로 나타났다. 협회가 매주 수요일 중량별 계란 기준가격을 결정해 문자나 팩스로 통지하면, 농가는 이를 토대로 산지 가격을 결정한 것이다.)

The Ministry judged that the association's actions violated the conditions of its establishment approval. Earlier in May, the Fair Trade Commission also deemed this conduct as price collusion and issued a corrective order and a fine of 594 million won against the association. The Ministry stated, "It is recognized that the public interest was harmed through violations of the Fair Trade Act while breaching the conditions that were prerequisites for the establishment approval," and announced the revocation of the nonprofit corporation's establishment approval under the Civil Act. (농식품부는 이 같은 협회의 행위는 설립 허가 조건을 위반한 것이라고 판단했다. 앞서 지난 5 월 공정위도 해당 행위를 가격 담합으로 판단하고, 협회에 대해 시정명령과 과징금 5억9400만원을 부과한 바 있다. 농식품부는 “설립 허가의 전제가 된 조건을 위반한 상태에서 공정거래법 위반행위로 공익을 침해한 사실이 인정된다”며 민법에 따라 비영리법인 설립 허가를 취소한다고 밝혔다.)

The association is protesting, arguing that the revocation of the establishment approval eliminates a channel for cooperation and communication between egg-producing farms and the government. The Ministry plans to continue policy consultations through laying hen farms affiliated with the Korea Poultry Association. (협회 쪽은 설립 허가 취소는 계란 생산 농가와 정부의 협력·소통 창구를 없애는 조처라며 반발하고 있다. 농식품부는 대한양계협회 소속 산란계 농가 등을 통해 정책 협의를 이어나가겠다는 방침이다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-joo kyj@hani.co.kr (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Mid-to-low-priced standard apartments' decreasing in Seoul's outskirts… Over half of apartments in Gwanak and Seongbuk exceed 900 million won (서울 외곽 ‘중저가 국평’ 줄어든다…관악·성북 아파트 절반 이상 9억 넘어)
item.description:
As Seoul's housing prices rise steeply, mid-to-low-priced standard-sized apartments (exclusive area of 59-85㎡) priced under 900 million won are decreasing even in Seoul's outskirts. Particularly in Gwanak-gu and Seongbuk-gu, only a year ago, 6 to 7 out of 10 standard-sized apartments were traded under 900 million won, but now that proportion has dropped sharply to below half. (서울 집값이 가파르게 오르면서 서울 외곽지역에도 9억원 이하 ‘중저가’ 국민평형(전용면적 59∼85㎡) 아파트가 줄어들고 있다. 특히 관악구와 성북구에서는 1년 전만 해도 국민평형 10채 가운데 6∼7채 꼴로 9억원 이하 거래를 찾아볼 수 있었지만, 지금은 그 비중이 절반 이하로 뚝 떨어졌다.)

According to the Hankyoreh's analysis of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport's actual transaction price disclosure system on the 29th, in the first half (January to June) of this year, among a total of 11,300 standard-sized apartment transactions (extracted on the 27th) in nine outer districts of Seoul (Nowon, Dobong, Gangbuk, Geumcheon, Gwanak, Guro, Seongbuk, Jungnang, and Gangseo-gu), transactions under 900 million won accounted for 68.3% (7,718 cases). This proportion decreased by 8.7 percentage points compared to the first half of 2025 (77.0%). This indicates that the lower price threshold for mid-to-low-priced apartments, which first-time homebuyers or practical demanders in their 30s could purchase using loans, is gradually rising. Market assessments suggest that the disappearance of cheap jeonse (long-term rental) properties has stimulated purchase demand for mid-to-low-priced apartments, significantly driving up housing prices in Seoul's outskirts. (29일 한겨레가 국토교통부 실거래가 공개시스템을 분석해보니, 올해 상반기(1∼6월) 서울 외곽 9개 자치구(노원·도봉·강북·금천·관악·구로·성북·중랑·강서구)에서 국민평형 아파트 거래가 총 1만1300건(지난 27일 추출) 이뤄진 가운데 9억원 이하 거래 비중이 68.3%(7718건)로 집계됐다. 9억원 이하 국민평형 거래 비중은 2025년 상반기(77.0%)와 견줘 8.7%포인트 줄었다. 생애 최초 주택 구매자나 30대 실수요층이 대출을 활용해 매수할 수 있었던 중저가 아파트의 하한선이 점차 올라가고 있는 셈이다. 저렴한 전세 물건이 사라지면서 중저가 아파트 매매수요를 건드려 서울 외곽 집값이 크게 뛰었다는 것이 시장의 평가다.)

The change was particularly steep in Gwanak-gu and Seongbuk-gu. In Gwanak-gu, the proportion of standard-sized apartment transactions under 900 million won stood at 48.2%, shrinking by over 23 percentage points compared to the same period last year (71.3%). During the same period, total standard-sized apartment transactions in Gwanak-gu only increased by 16.4%, but transactions exceeding 900 million won surged more than twofold (110%). In Seongbuk-gu, the proportion of standard-sized apartment transactions under 900 million won also dropped sharply from 67.1% in the first half of 2025 to 48.6% in the first half of this year. While total standard-sized apartment transactions in Seongbuk-gu decreased by 9.7%, transactions exceeding 900 million won increased by 41%. (특히 관악구와 성북구에서 그 변화가 유난히 가팔랐다. 관악구에서 이뤄진 국민평형 아파트 거래 가운데 9억원 이하 비중은 48.2%로 1년 전 같은 기간(71.3%)과 견줘 23%포인트 넘게 쪼그라들었다. 같은 기간 관악구 전체 국민평형 거래는 16.4%에 늘어나는데 그쳤지만, 9억원 초과 거래는 2배(110%) 넘게 폭증한 탓이다. 성북구의 국민평형 아파트 거래 가운데 9억원 이하 비중 역시 2025년 상반기 67.1%에서 올해 상반기 48.6%로 크게 줄었다. 성북구는 전체 국민평형 거래는 9.7% 줄었는데 9억원 초과 거래만 41% 늘었다.)

The complex leading the price increase for standard-sized apartments in Gwanak-gu is 'Gwanak Byucksan Blooming' in Bongcheon-dong. Last year, there were only 22 actual transactions exceeding 900 million won, but in the first half of this year, this number explosively increased threefold to 66 cases. Similarly, 'Gwanak Woosung Apartment' in Bongcheon-dong saw transactions over 900 million won rise from 18 cases last year to 39 cases in the first half of this year, more than doubling. In Seongbuk-gu, 'Doosan Apartment' in Seokgwan-dong, which had no transactions exceeding 900 million won last year, led the price surge. This complex recorded 27 transactions over 900 million won this year, and in June, an 84㎡ unit was traded at 1.04 billion won, setting a new record high. (관악구의 국민평형 가격 상승을 주도한 단지는 봉천동 ‘관악벽산블루밍’이다. 지난해에는 9억원 초과 실거래가 22건에 불과했지만 올해 상반기에는 66건으로 3배가량 폭발적으로 증가했다. 봉천동 ‘관악우성아파트’ 역시 지난해 18건에 그쳤던 9억원 초과 거래가 올해 상반기 39건으로 두배 이상 뛰었다. 성북구에서도 지난해 9억원 초과 거래가 전무했던 석관동 ‘두산아파트’가 가격 상승을 주도했다. 이 단지는 올해 들어 9억원 초과 거래가 27건에 이르렀고 지난 6월에는 84㎡가 10억4천만원에 거래되며 신고가를 찍었다.)

Similar trends were observed in other mid-to-low-priced apartment markets in Seoul, such as Nowon, Gangbuk, Geumcheon, and Guro. In Nowon-gu, the proportion of standard-sized apartment transactions under 900 million won fell from 89.4% in the first half of last year to 80.5% in the first half of this year. Gangbuk-gu, which was a representative 'mid-to-low-priced market' last year with 96.3% of standard-sized apartment transactions under 900 million won, saw this drop to 81.6% this year. Geumcheon-gu decreased from 84.2% to 74.9%, and Guro-gu from 80.8% to 74.8%, respectively. (이 같은 현상은 노원, 강북, 금천, 구로 등 다른 서울 내 중저가 아파트 시장에서도 비슷하게 나타났다. 노원구는 지난해 상반기 9억원 이하 국민평형 거래가 89.4%였는데 올해 상반기엔 80.5%로 떨어졌다. 강북구는 지난해만 해도 9억원 이하 국민평형 거래가 96.3%에 이르는 대표적인 ‘중저가 시장’이었으나 올해는 81.6%로 줄었다. 금천구는 84.2%에서 74.9%로, 구로구는 80.8%에서 74.8%로 각각 9억원 이하 국민평형 거래가 줄었다.)

Meanwhile, Dobong-gu and Jungnang-gu still maintain around 90% of transactions under 900 million won, showing robust price defense. Dobong-gu recorded 91.6% of standard-sized apartment transactions under 900 million won, a slight decrease from last year (95.7%). Jungnang-gu also showed little change, from 89.8% last year to 87.5% this year. Nam Hyuk-woo, a researcher at Woori Bank's Real Estate Research Institute, said, "Within Seoul, there appears to be a time lag in price increases depending on physical location. In the outermost areas like Dobong-gu or Jungnang-gu, there aren't many new apartments to drive high-priced transactions, so purchase demand is being dispersed to satellite cities in Gyeonggi Province, where new apartments are concentrated." (한편 도봉구와 중랑구는 여전히 9억원 이하 거래가 90% 안팎을 나타내며 견고하게 가격을 방어하고 있다. 도봉구의 9억원 이하 국민평형 거래는 91.6%로 지난해(95.7%)보다 소폭 줄었다. 중랑구 역시 지난해 89.8%에서 올해 87.5%로 큰 변화를 나타내지 않았다. 남혁우 우리은행 부동산연구원은 “서울 내에서도 물리적 위치에 따라 가격 상승의 시차가 발생하는 모양새”라며 “도봉구나 중랑구 등 최외곽 지역의 경우 고가 거래를 이끌 신축 아파트가 많지 않아서, 신축 아파트가 밀집된 경기도의 위성도시로 매매 수요가 분산되고 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (이지혜 기자 godot@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Financial Services Commission Chairman: “Considering Restricting New Purchases of Samsung and SK Hynix Leverage Products to Professional Investors Only” (금융위원장 “삼전·닉스 레버리지, 전문투자자만 신규매수 허용 검토”)
item.description:
Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won and Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin both stated that they bear “heavy responsibility” over criticisms that Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix single-stock leverage products have increased volatility in the domestic stock market. Chairman Lee Eok-won also mentioned that additional measures, including restricting new purchases to professional investors only, could be considered. Recent losses incurred by domestic individual investors from single-stock leverage products are estimated at approximately 32 trillion won. (이억원 금융위원장과 이찬진 금융감독원장이 삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 ‘단일종목 레버리지’ 상품이 국내 주식시장의 변동성을 키웠다는 지적에 대해 나란히 “책임이 무겁다”고 밝혔다. 이억원 위원장은 전문투자자에게만 신규 매수를 허용하는 추가 대책도 검토할 수 있다고 밝혔다. 최근 단일종목 레버리지 상품으로 인한 국내 개인투자자 손실은 약 32조원으로 추산된다.)

During a policy report to the National Assembly’s Steering Committee on the 29th, Chairman Lee responded to a question from People Power Party lawmaker Park Dae-chul, who asked if he agreed with the diagnosis that the single-stock leverage crash was a “man-made disaster by the Financial Services Commission and the Financial Supervisory Service,” saying, “As an authority figure, I feel very heavy responsibility for the significant expansion of market volatility.” Governor Lee Chan-jin also stated, “I accept the responsibility heavily.” Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-chul, who attended the policy report to the National Assembly’s Strategy and Finance Committee, also apologized, saying, “I regret that we did not thoroughly manage the aspects when launching the product.” <<> In response to criticisms that general investors should have restricted access to single-stock leverage products, Chairman Lee replied, “If necessary, we can consider methods such as limiting investment requirements to professional investors.” A professional individual investor refers to someone who has held an average monthly balance of 50 million won or more in financial investment products for at least one of the past five years and meets one of the income, asset, or expertise requirements. Additionally, members of the Steering Committee called for raising the deposit requirement to 50 million won and adjusting the current target leverage ratio of 2x downwards. <<> However, Chairman Lee stated that the effects of the deposit increase measure, effective from the 31st, should first be observed. Chairman Lee said, “If the deposit (currently 10 million won) is raised to 30 million won in cash, daily trading volume will decrease by about 60%.” According to measures announced on the 16th, starting from the 31st, the deposit required to purchase single-stock leverage products will increase from 10 million won to 30 million won in cash, and it is explained that even this measure alone will significantly dampen demand. <<> Opposition lawmakers also raised the issue of responsibility for Kim Yong-beom, head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination at the Presidential Office. They argue that due to Director Kim’s instructions, the product was hastily introduced without sufficient review. Chairman Lee refuted this, saying, “It was launched after going through all necessary procedures.” Director Kim, who accompanied President Lee Jae-myung on a state visit to Brazil on the 28th (local time), met with reporters and said, “Over the past 2-3 months, it wasn’t just us (experiencing high volatility),” adding, “Regarding the structural factors that make (stock market) volatility particularly pronounced, we will aim to examine not just (single-stock) leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs), but also the overall situation, and the Financial Services Commission and Financial Supervisory Service will conduct a review.” <<> Meanwhile, on this day, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares closed at 208,500 won and 1,401,000 won, down 5.23% and 9.61% from the previous day, respectively. Compared to closing prices on the 1st of this month, they have plunged 33.70% and 45.27% in less than a month. For single-stock leverage products designed to track twice the daily return, losses over the same period were 60.68% for the Samsung Electronics product (based on Samsung Asset Management’s product) and 75.14% for the SK Hynix product. Global investment bank Citigroup estimated that domestic individual investors incurred losses of approximately 32 trillion won from these two single-stock leverage products. <<> Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr, Senior Reporter Jo Gye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr, Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr, Reporter Shin Min-jeong shin@hani.co.kr (이 위원장은 29일 국회에서 열린 정무위원회 업무보고에서 “단일종목 레버리지 폭락 사태는 금융위와 금감원발 인재라는 진단에 동의하느냐”는 박대출 국민의힘 의원의 질문에 “시장 변동성이 크게 확대된 데 대해 당국자로서 (책임이) 매우 무겁게 생각하고 있다”고 답했다. 이찬진 원장도 “책임을 무겁게 받아들이고 있다”고 말했다. 이날 국회 재정경제기획위원회 업무보고에 참석한 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관도 “상품을 출시할 때 꼼꼼하게 못 챙긴 측면은 송구하게 생각한다”고 사과했다.)

item.title: SK Hynix -22.85%, Samsung Electronics -17.91%...Plummeted in Just Two Days (SK하이닉스 –22.85%, 삼성전자 –17.91%…이틀 만에 빠졌다)
item.description:
SK Hynix reported an all-time high operating profit of approximately 60.5 trillion won in the second quarter of this year, but its stock price plunged nearly 10%, dampening the overall stock market. This was because the second-quarter results fell short of market expectations and failed to ease investor fears over the artificial intelligence (AI) investment bubble and China’s semiconductor catching-up. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 올해 2분기 60조5천억원에 이르는 사상 최대 영업이익을 기록했으나, 정작 주가는 10% 가까이 급락하며 증시 전반에 찬물을 끼얹었다. 2분기 실적이 시장 기대치를 밑돈 데다, 인공지능(AI) 투자 거품 및 중국의 반도체 추격 등 투자자들의 공포 심리를 완화하기에 역부족이었기 때문이다.)

On the 29th, SK Hynix announced that its operating profit for the second quarter (April to June) on a consolidated basis was provisionally tallied at 60.5426 trillion won. This represents a 557.2% increase compared to the same period last year and a 61.0% surge from the previous quarter. (29일 에스케이하이닉스는 지난 2분기(4∼6월) 연결 재무제표 기준 영업이익이 60조5426억원으로 잠정 집계됐다고 밝혔다. 이는 지난해 같은 기간에 견줘 557.2%, 직전 분기 대비로는 61.0% 급증한 규모다.)

Second-quarter revenue also reached 79.3187 trillion won, growing 256.8% year-on-year and 50.9% from the first quarter. As a result, cumulative revenue for the first half of this year hit approximately 131.9 trillion won, surpassing the 100 trillion won mark for the first time. (2분기 매출액도 79조3187억원으로 전년 동기 대비 256.8%, 앞선 1분기보다는 50.9% 불어났다. 이에 따라 올해 상반기 누적 매출액은 약 131조9천억원을 기록하며 처음으로 100조원을 돌파했다.)

Despite achieving record quarterly operating profit and revenue due to deepening memory supply shortages and sharp price increases, SK Hynix’s stock price on the Korea Exchange closed at 1.401 million won per share, down 9.61% from the previous trading day. This is because the second-quarter results were evaluated as an "earnings miss," falling short of market forecasts, fueling investor sentiment of a "semiconductor peak-out" (a slowdown after a peak). Earlier, securities firms had projected second-quarter revenue and operating profit at 82.6 trillion won and 63.2 trillion won, respectively. (메모리 공급 부족 심화, 가격 급등 영향으로 역대 최대 분기 영업이익과 매출액을 달성했지만, 이날 유가증권 시장에서 에스케이하이닉스 주가는 전 거래일 대비 9.61% 하락한 주당 140만1천원에 마감했다. 2분기 실적이 시장 전망을 하회하는 ‘어닝 미스’로 평가되며 투자자들의 ‘반도체 피크아웃’(정점 후 둔화) 심리가 확산한 탓이다. 앞서 증권가에서 예상했던 2분기 매출액과 영업이익은 각각 82조6천억원, 63조2천억원이었다.)

On the same day, Samsung Electronics’ stock price also plunged 5.23%, and the KOSPI index closed at 5663.24, down 5.98% from the previous day. This marks the first time in about three months, since April 14 of this year (5967.75), that the 6,000-point level has been breached. The decline was more pronounced compared to other Asian stock markets, such as China’s Shanghai Composite Index (0.4%), Japan’s Nikkei 225 Index (-1.49%), and Taiwan’s Taiex Index (-3.76%). The KOSPI and KOSDAQ markets triggered circuit breakers for the second consecutive day, halting trading for 20 minutes—the first time in history that both markets have seen back-to-back circuit breakers. SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics stocks dropped 22.85% and 17.91%, respectively, in just two days. (이날 삼성전자 주가도 5.23% 급락하는 등 코스피는 전일 대비 5.98% 내린 5663.24에 장을 마쳤다. 올해 4월14일(5967.75) 이후 3개월여 만에 6천선이 무너진 것이다. 이날 중국 상하이종합지수(0.4%), 일본 닛케이225 지수(-1.49%), 대만 자취안 지수(-3.76%) 등 다른 아시아 증시에 견줘 낙폭이 두드러졌다. 코스피와 코스닥은 어제에 이어 이틀 연속 20분간 매매가 중단되는 서킷 브레이커가 발동됐는데, 두 시장에 연이틀 서킷 브레이커가 발동된 것은 사상 처음이다. 에스케이하이닉스와 삼성전자 주가는 불과 이틀 만에 22.85%와 17.91% 빠졌다.)

In an earnings call that day, SK Hynix actively refuted concerns about a semiconductor peak-out, stating, "We are currently finalizing long-term supply agreements (LTA) with about ten customer companies, securing mid- to long-term supply stability." (에스케이하이닉스는 이날 실적 설명회에서 “현재까지 10여개 고객사와 메모리 장기공급계약(LTA) 협상을 마무리하며 중장기적인 공급 안정성을 확보하고 있다”며 반도체 피크아웃 우려를 적극 반박했다.)

Reporter Park Jong-oh pjo2@hani.co.kr (박종오 기자 pjo2@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Co-authored Book 'Explorations in Korean Generative Syntax' by Professor Jeong-Hoon Lee of Sogang University's Department of Korean Language and Literature Selected as Outstanding Academic Book by the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea (서강대학교 국어국문학과 이정훈 교수 공저서 '한국어생성통사론탐구', 대한민국학술원 우수학술도서 선정)
item.description:
'Explorations in Korean Generative Syntax' (co-authored by Ki-yong Choi, Yong-ha Kim, Jeong-Hoon Lee, and So-young Park), co-authored by Professor Jeong-Hoon Lee of the Department of Korean Language and Literature at Sogang University (President Jong-hyuk Shim), has been selected as an 'Outstanding Academic Book of 2026' by the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea. (서강대학교(총장 심종혁) 국어국문학과 이정훈 교수의 공저서 ‘한국어 생성 통사론 탐구’(최기용, 김용하, 이정훈, 박소영 공저)가 ‘2026년 대한민국학술원 우수학술도서’로 선정되었다.)

Since 2002, the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea has been selecting outstanding academic books in basic academic fields and distributing them to domestic universities to promote research and writing activities in these fields. The academy selects excellent academic books through multi-stage reviews by a committee composed of academy members and experts, targeting academic books in all basic academic fields that were first published domestically from March of the previous year to February of the current year. <<> (대한민국학술원은 2002년부터 기초학문 분야 우수학술도서를 선정하여 국내 대학에 보급함으로써 기초학문분야 연구 및 저술 활동 활성화를 도모하고 있으며, 전년도 3월부터 당해연도 2월까지 국내에서 초판 발행된 기초학문 전분야 학술도서를 대상으로, 학술원 회원 및 전문가로 구성된 심사위원회의 다단계 심사를 통해 우수학술도서를 선정한다.)

Professor Jeong-Hoon Lee's latest co-authored book is a theoretical linguistic research achievement that is not easily encountered in Korean language studies. It deeply analyzes and explains Korean linguistic phenomena based on the minimalism of generative grammar. Its significance is particularly great in that it does not merely passively adopt minimalist theory but actively seeks to revise and develop the theory based on specific Korean linguistic phenomena. <<> ()

Furthermore, 'Explorations in Korean Generative Syntax,' selected as an outstanding academic book this time, is the follow-up to the previous work 'Korean Generative Syntax' (co-authored by Yong-ha Kim, So-young Park, Jeong-Hoon Lee, and Ki-yong Choi, selected as an Outstanding Academic Book of 2018 by the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea). Its significance is even greater in that it demonstrates a successful case of collaborative research transcending academic lineages and regions. (이정훈 교수의 이번 공저서는 한국어 연구에서는 쉽게 접할 수 없는 이론 언어학적 연구 성과로서 생성문법(generative grammar)의 최소주의(minimalism)를 토대로 한국어 현상을 심도있게 분석하고 설명한 업적이다. 특히 최소주의 이론을 수동적으로 수용하는 데에 머물지 않고 구체적인 한국어 현상을 토대로 이론의 개정 및 발전을 적극적으로 도모했다는 점에서 그 의의가 자못 크다.)

item.title: "Six Years of Persistent 'Puzzle-Solving' Led to Uncovering Wheat Flour Price Collusion" (“끈질긴 ‘퍼즐 맞추기’ 끝에 6년 밀가루 담합 적발했죠”)
item.description:
"It felt like putting together a complex puzzle, piece by piece." (“복잡한 퍼즐을 하나씩 맞춰가는 것 같았어요.”)

Kim Jong-wan, a secretary at the Korea Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) who led the investigation team for the wheat flour price collusion case—which resulted in the second-largest fine in collusion history this past May—shared the challenges of the probe in an interview with *The Hankyoreh* at the KFTC office in Sejong on the 22nd. At that time, seven flour milling companies, including CJ CheilJedang and Daesun Flour Mills, were slapped with a combined fine of 671 billion won for colluding on the price of wheat flour supplied to confectionery companies from 2019 to last year. ( 지난 5월 담합 사건 중 역대 두번째로 큰 과징금이 부과된 밀가루 담합의 전담조사팀장이었던 김종완 공정거래위원회 서기관은 지난 22일 세종 공정위에서 한겨레와 만나 조사 과정의 어려움을 이렇게 말했다. 당시 씨제이(CJ)제일제당과 대선제분 등 7개 제분사는 2019년부터 지난해까지 제과업체에 공급하는 밀가루 가격을 짬짜미한 혐의로 공정위로부터 6710억원의 과징금 부과 처분을 받았다. )

Clues of wheat flour collusion uncovered during sugar price-fixing probe
Teams split for simultaneous investigations of seven mills
Cross-verification with statements and evidence from other companies
"Meticulous strategies, including response scenarios, carefully prepared
Usually takes a year, but resolved in four months" ( 설탕 담합 조사 중 밀가루 정황 포착
7개 제분사별로 팀 나눠 동시 조사
다른 업체 쪽 진술·자료로 교차 검증
“답변별 시나리오 등 전략 꼼꼼히 세워
통상 1년 걸리는데 네달 만에 해결”)

The 'puzzle-solving' began from the initial stages of the investigation. "The wheat flour collusion probe started when the KFTC, while investigating sugar price-fixing, picked up clues of wheat flour collusion through companies involved in both schemes. During the on-site inspections to secure evidence, we divided into teams for each mill and conducted simultaneous investigations. Our staff communicated in real time and shared information organically, which was a big help. At the company I was assigned to, they initially denied the collusion, but I presented evidence uncovered from other companies' investigations and persuaded them that denial was pointless, leading to their cooperation." ( ‘퍼즐 맞추기’는 조사 착수 단계부터 시작됐다. “밀가루 담합 조사는 공정위가 설탕 담합을 조사하던 과정에서 두가지 담합 모두에 참여한 업체들을 통해 밀가루 담합 정황도 포착하면서 이뤄졌습니다. 증거를 확보하기 위한 현장조사 단계에서도 제분사별로 팀을 나눠 동시에 조사를 나간 직원들이 실시간 유기적으로 소통하면서 정보를 공유했던 것이 도움됐습니다. 제가 맡은 업체에서는 처음에 담합 사실을 부인했는데, 다른 업체 조사에서 확인된 증거를 제시하면서 부인해도 무의미하다는 취지로 설득해 협조를 끌어냈습니다.”)

Secretary Kim also said, "By collecting KakaoTalk conversations, emails, work notebook memos, and corporate card receipts from employees of each company, we found that evidence from Company A confirmed 10 meetings with other mills, while evidence from Company B confirmed 5 meetings. For meetings verified by evidence from only one company, we cross-checked with statements from other companies. As a result, we determined that at least 55 meetings took place." ( 김 서기관은 또 “각 업체 직원들의 카카오톡 대화, 이메일, 업무수첩 메모, 법인카드 영수증 등을 모아보니 ㄱ업체에서 확보한 증거로는 다른 제분사들과의 10차례 만남이, ㄴ업체 증거에서는 5차례 만남이 확인되는 식이었다”며 “업체 한곳의 증거로만 확인되는 만남에 대해서는 다른 업체 쪽 진술을 통해 교차 검증했고, 그 결과 최소 55차례 만났다는 점을 파악할 수 있었다”고 말했다.)

In the process of gathering statements from mill employees and verifying evidence, he mobilized all the know-how accumulated over years of investigating collusion cases. While such probes typically take over a year, this case was unusually resolved in just four months. He said, "There were many points to verify through statements, and to secure just one statement, I spent entire days preparing scenarios for each possible response. Since patterns similar to the 2006 wheat flour collusion case repeated, I also referenced strategies used back then." ( 제분사 직원들에게 진술을 받고 증거를 검증하는 과정에서는 그간 담합 사건을 조사하며 쌓아온 노하우를 총동원했다고 한다. 통상 담합 조사에는 1년 이상 걸리지만, 이 사건은 이례적으로 4개월 만에 빠르게 해결했다. 그는 “진술을 통해 확인해야 하는 사항이 많았는데, 진술 한건을 받기 위해 답변 내용별 시나리오를 종일 준비했을 정도로 전략을 꼼꼼히 세웠다”며 “2006년에 밀가루 담합이 적발됐을 당시와 비슷한 패턴이 반복돼, 과거에 활용된 전략을 참고하기도 했다”고 말했다.)

Four banks caught exchanging real estate information
"Rewarding to handle cases that greatly impact people's lives" ( 부동산 정보 교환한 4개 은행도 적발
“국민 생활에 영향 큰 사건 맡아 보람”)

Secretary Kim also led the investigation into KB Kookmin, Shinhan, Woori, and Hana Banks, which were accused of exchanging extensive information on their loan-to-value (LTV) ratios for real estate—ranging from at least 736 to up to 7,500 data points—over a prolonged period. In January, the KFTC imposed fines totaling 272 billion won on the four banks. This was the first case where the prohibition on information exchange collusion was applied. "Proving that LTV information is competitively sensitive was crucial, so after securing the banks' internal regulations, we sifted through thousands of pages of fine print to find relevant content and collect evidence. Our team members all complained of eye fatigue." ( 김 서기관은 국민·신한·우리·하나은행이 최소 736건에서 최대 7500건에 이르는 각 은행의 부동산 담보인정비율(LTV) 정보 전체를 장기간에 걸쳐 서로 교환한 혐의와 관련해서도 전담 조사팀장을 맡았다. 공정위는 지난 1월 4개 은행에 대해 과징금 2720억원을 부과했다. 정보 교환 담합 금지 규정이 적용된 첫 사례다. “엘티브이가 경쟁상 민감한 정보라는 점을 입증하는 것이 중요해, 은행 내부 규정을 확보한 뒤 수천장에 걸쳐 깨알같이 적힌 규정에서 관련 내용을 찾고 증거를 수집했습니다. 팀원들이 모두 눈의 피로감을 호소할 정도였죠.”)

In recognition of these achievements, Secretary Kim received a special performance bonus of 3 million won from the KFTC on the 9th. The total bonuses awarded to the investigation teams for the wheat flour and bank LTV collusion cases amounted to 15 million won. ( 김 서기관은 이런 성과를 인정받아 지난 9일 공정위로부터 특별성과 포상금 300만원을 받았다. 밀가루, 은행 엘티브이 등 담합 전담조사팀에 지급된 포상금은 총 1500만원이다.)

While investigating these two cases, he said, "I once again realized how significantly the KFTC's role impacts people's daily lives." He added, "There were times when acquaintances, unaware that I was handling the wheat flour case, contacted me saying, 'The KFTC really did something big this time.' Since wheat flour is a key ingredient for foods like ramen, bread, and snacks, the collusion's impact on the public was enormous, and I felt just how high public interest was. The bank LTV collusion particularly affected small and medium-sized enterprises and small business owners heavily reliant on mortgage loans. It was rewarding to handle such cases with my colleagues, and I will continue to strive to contribute to the KFTC fulfilling its role." ( 그는 두 사건을 조사하면서 “공정위의 역할이 국민 생활에 얼마나 큰 영향을 미치는지 새삼 다시 느끼게 됐다”고 했다. “밀가루 담합 사건을 제가 담당했다는 사실을 모르고 주변에서 ‘이번에 공정위가 큰일 했더라’고 연락이 오는 경우도 있었습니다. 밀가루가 라면, 빵, 과자 등 먹거리의 핵심 원재료인 만큼 담합이 국민에게 미치는 영향이 크고 그만큼 국민 관심도도 높다는 점을 체감했죠. 은행 엘티브이 담합은 담보대출 의존도가 높은 중소기업, 소상공인 등에게 특히 영향이 컸습니다. 동료들과 함께 이런 사건을 맡을 수 있어 보람찼고, 앞으로도 공정위가 역할을 다하는 데 보탬이 되기 위해 노력하겠습니다.”)

Secretary Kim began his public service career at the Korean National Railroad in 1996, transferred to the KFTC in 2004, and has served in the Daejeon Regional Fair Trade Office, the Corporate Transaction Policy Division, the Competition Policy Division, and the Service Industry Surveillance Division. From February 2020 to March 2026, over the recent six years, he has handled collusion cases in various departments of the Cartel Investigation Bureau, earning a reputation within the KFTC as a 'collusion expert.' He currently works as the head of the Business Support Team. ( 김 서기관은 1996년 철도청에서 공직을 시작해 2004년 공정위로 전입했고, 대전지방공정거래사무소, 기업거래정책과, 경쟁정책과, 서비스업감시과 등을 거쳤다. 2020년 2월부터 2026년 3월까지 최근 약 6년간은 카르텔조사국의 여러 과에서 담합 사건 조사를 담당해 공정위 내에서도 ‘담합 전문가’로 꼽힌다. 현재는 업무지원팀장으로 근무 중이다.)

item.title: China accelerates development of lithography equipment and its own AI ecosystem, but are there limits? (중국, 노광장비 개발·자체 AI생태계 구축 속도내지만 한계는?)
item.description:
China is emerging as a new variable in the market competition landscape surrounding the domestic semiconductor industry, as it accelerates its self-reliance in semiconductor equipment following the development of its own artificial intelligence (AI) models. Amid US export restrictions, China's push to develop its own lithography equipment—used to etch integrated circuits onto semiconductor substrates according to design blueprints—and build a semiconductor ecosystem raises the possibility of impacting the global semiconductor supply chain reorganization. However, in the field of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), a key area of AI semiconductor competition that requires advanced processes and packaging technology, some predict it will be difficult for China to catch up with South Korea in the short term. <<> According to multiple foreign media reports compiled on the 29th, immersion deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography equipment developed by Chinese state-owned enterprises is expected to be delivered to major Chinese semiconductor companies such as SMIC, Hua Hong Semiconductor, and CXMT within this year. This is why analysis suggests that China's technological capabilities have emerged as a variable in the global AI supply chain, as it moves away from dependence on Netherlands-based ASML, which has monopolized the global lithography equipment market. <<> Lithography equipment is a core tool in semiconductor production. The DUV lithography equipment made by China uses light with a wavelength of 193 nanometers (nm), but to achieve circuit patterns at the level of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) used in advanced processes, a 'multi-patterning' process requiring multiple repetitions must be employed. While this increases process complexity and puts it at a disadvantage in terms of productivity and yield, industry insiders note that the significance lies in China producing lithography equipment independently amid US export restrictions. <<> Beyond equipment localization, China is also accelerating the construction of its AI ecosystem. Early this year, Chinese AI startup DeepSeek unveiled a 'cost-effective AI model' that can reduce dependence on HBM. Unlike US hyperscale AI, which heavily relies on NVIDIA's GPUs and HBM, China is building an AI ecosystem by utilizing domestic general-purpose memory. <<> Chinese AI companies are also expanding compatibility with their domestic semiconductor ecosystem. A representative example is Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI, which is pushing to optimize the 'Kimi K3' AI model—reportedly catching up to Anthropic and OpenAI—to run on Chinese-made AI chips. <<> Despite China's efforts to build its own semiconductor ecosystem, analysis indicates that Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix still maintain a clear advantage in the high-value-added memory sector. This is because HBM requires not only micro-processing based on EUV lithography equipment but also advanced packaging and joint development with customers, making its entry barriers higher than those for general-purpose memory. Such technological competitiveness underlies the two companies' expansion of long-term memory supply contracts with US Big Tech firms and cooperation in building AI data centers. The state-run Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) recently analyzed in its report 'China's Semiconductor Industry Innovation and Global Competitiveness' that "in most areas, South Korea appears to be 3 to 6 years ahead of China." An industry insider noted, "The target markets for China and Samsung Electronics/SK Hynix are different. The majority of memory customers are US Big Tech companies, making it difficult for China to narrow the gap with Korean companies in the short term." <<> By Bae Ji-hyun, Reporter beep@hani.co.kr (중국이 자체 인공지능(AI) 모델 개발에 이어 반도체 장비 자립에도 속도를 내면서 국내 반도체 업계를 둘러싼 시장 경쟁 구도에 새로운 변수로 떠오르고 있다. 미국의 수출 규제 속에서 자체 노광장비(반도체 기판에 설계도에 따라 집적회로를 그려 넣는 장비) 개발과 반도체 생태계 구축에 나서면서 글로벌 반도체 공급망 재편에도 영향을 미칠 가능성이 제기된다. 다만 인공지능 반도체 경쟁의 핵심인 고대역폭메모리(HBM) 분야는 첨단 공정과 패키징 기술이 뒷받침돼야 하는 영역인 만큼, 중국이 단기간에 한국을 추격하기는 어려울 것이란 관측이 나온다.)

item.title: Sangji University Appoints Professor Bang Jeong-gyun of the College of Korean Medicine as its 10th President (상지대 제10대 총장, 한의과대학 방정균 교수 임명)
item.description:
The school foundation, Sangji Hakwon (Chairman Park Geo-yong), held a board meeting on the 29th and appointed Professor Bang Jeong-gyun of the College of Korean Medicine as the 10th President of Sangji University. (학교법인 상지학원(이사장 박거용)은 29일 이사회를 개최하여 상지대 제)

The school foundation, Sangji Hakwon (Chairman Park Geo-yong), held a board meeting on the 29th and appointed Professor Bang Jeong-gyun of the College of Korean Medicine as the 10th President of Sangji University. The term of the new President Bang is four years, from August 1, 2026, to July 31, 2030. (학교법인 상지학원(이사장 박거용)은 29일 이사회를 개최하여 상지대 제10대 총장으로 한의과대학 방정균 교수를 임명했다. 방 신임 총장의 임기는 2026년 8월 1일부터 2030년 7월 31일까지 4년간이다.)

( )

The new President Bang Jeong-gyun entered Sangji University in 1988 as a member of the first class of the College of Korean Medicine. After being appointed as a professor at the College of Korean Medicine in 2002, he has accumulated diverse experiences in education, research, and university administration. (신임 방정균 총장은 1988년 상지대 한의과대학 1기로 입학했으며, 2002년 한의과대학 교수로 임용된 이후 교육과 연구는 물론 대학 행정 분야에서도 다양한 경험을 쌓아왔다.)

Notably, since 2017, he has served as the Director of the Legal Affairs Bureau for the school foundation Sangji Hakwon, Director of the Office of External Cooperation at Sangji University, and Vice President, handling key university policies and external cooperation tasks, contributing to the university's development and the strengthening of community partnerships. (특히 2017년부터 학교법인 상지학원 법인국장, 상지대 대외협력처장, 부총장 등을 역임하며 대학의 주요 정책과 대외협력 업무를 수행했으며, 대학 발전과 지역사회 협력 강화에 기여했다.)

Additionally, in 2020, he served as a member of the Private School Dispute Mediation Committee under the Ministry of Education, striving to advance the private school system and enhance the public nature of university operations. In 2021, he served as the Senior Secretary for Civil Society in the Presidential Office at Cheong Wa Dae, gaining broad experience in the education and public sectors. (또한 2020년에는 교육부 사학분쟁조정위원회 위원으로 활동하며 사학 제도 발전과 대학 운영의 공공성 제고에 힘썼고, 2021년에는 청와대 대통령비서실 시민사회수석을 역임하는 등 교육과 공공 분야에서 폭넓은 경험을 쌓았다.)

President Bang Jeong-gyun plans to enhance the university's competitiveness based on his expertise in Korean medicine, university administrative experience, and external cooperation capabilities. He aims to lead the university's sustainable development through educational innovation, strengthening research capabilities, and fostering industry-academia collaboration and coexistence with the local community. (방정균 총장은 한의학 분야의 전문성과 대학 행정 경험, 대외협력 역량을 바탕으로 대학의 경쟁력을 높이고, 교육혁신과 연구 역량 강화, 산학협력 및 지역사회와의 상생을 통해 대학의 지속 가능한 발전을 이끌어 나갈 계획이다.)

Meanwhile, candidate Jeon Man-bok (former Vice President of Catholic Kwandong University), who applied for the presidency, expressed his intention to withdraw his candidacy after the public hearing. (한편 총장 공모에 지원한 전만복(전 가톨릭관동대학교 부총장)후보는 공청회 이후 후보사퇴 의사를 표명하였다.)

item.title: Government to Set Individual Investment Limits on Single-Stock Leverage Products… Also Reducing the Leverage Ratio to 2x (정부, 단일종목 레버리지 개인별 투자한도 설정…‘2배’ 배율도 낮춘다)
item.description:
The government has decided to manage the total volume of single-stock leverage products, which have been identified as a factor amplifying stock market volatility, by setting individual investment limits. (정부가 증시 변동성을 키우는 요인으로 지목된 단일종목 레버리지 상품에 대해 개인별 투자한도를 설정하는 등 총량을 관리하기로 했다.)

Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol announced at an emergency joint market situation assessment meeting held at the Government Complex Seoul on the 29th that this measure would be implemented immediately. The meeting was urgently convened to discuss countermeasures after the KOSPI plummeted for two consecutive days. Attendees included Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Uk-won, Financial Supervisory Service Director Lee Chan-jin, and Blue House Senior Economic Secretary Ha Joon-kyung. (구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 29일 정부서울청사에서 관계기관 합동 긴급 시장상황점검회의를 열어 이 같은 방안을 즉시 추진한다고 밝혔다. 코스피가 이틀 연속 급락하자 대책을 논의하기 위해 긴급 소집됐다. 회의에는 신현송 한국은행 총재, 이억원 금융위원회 위원장, 이찬진 금융감독원장, 하준경 청와대 경제성장수석 등이 참석했다.)

The government first decided to manage the total amount of funds flowing into single-stock leverage products, including by setting individual investment limits. One example proposed was restricting the proportion of individual total investments in single-stock leverage products to within 20%. (정부는 우선 개인별 투자한도를 설정하는 등 단일종목 레버리지 상품에 들어가는 자금의 총량을 관리하기로 했다. 개인의 총 투자금액 가운데 단일종목 레버리지 상품 비중을 20% 이내로 제한하는 방안이 예시로 제시됐다.)

Additionally, to curb excessive trading behavior, the government plans to increase related transaction costs by applying measures such as the excessive order fee currently used in the futures market. To help investors make more cautious decisions, simulated trading will also be introduced alongside the existing pre-education programs. (또 과도한 거래행태를 제한하기 위해 선물시장에서 운영 중인 과다호가부담금을 적용하는 등의 방식으로 관련 거래비용 부담을 가중하기로 했다. 투자자의 신중한 판단을 돕기 위해 현재 실시하는 사전교육 외에 모의거래도 도입한다.)

Furthermore, considering cases such as Hong Kong's adjustment of leverage ratios, the government will establish a legal basis for authorities to take market stabilization measures in emergency situations. Recently, Hong Kong financial authorities revised their system to flexibly lower the leverage ratio of leveraged and inverse products to a maximum of 2x depending on market conditions. (아울러 홍콩의 레버리지 배율 조정 사례 등을 고려해 긴급한 상황에서 당국이 시장 안정화 조처를 할 수 있는 법적 근거를 마련하기로 했다. 최근 홍콩 금융당국은 시장 상황에 따라 레버리지·인버스 상품의 배율을 최대 2배 이내에서 탄력적으로 낮출 수 있도록 제도를 손질했다.)

Regarding the recent sharp decline in the stock market, particularly in the semiconductor sector, the attendees assessed that "it largely reflects an expansion of the decline due to weakened investor sentiment and supply-demand instability amid a correction following a sharp surge in stock prices." They added, "The fundamentals of our economy remain robust, with continued strong exports of key items like semiconductors, upward revisions in corporate earnings forecasts, and a widening current account surplus. Care is needed to avoid the excessive spread of undue anxiety about the outlook for our stock market." (이날 참석자들은 최근 주식시장이 반도체 업종을 중심으로 큰 폭 하락한 데 대해 “그간 주가 급등에 따른 조정 과정에서의 투자심리 위축과 수급 불안이 낙폭을 확대시킨 측면이 크다”고 평가했다. 또 “반도체 등 주력품목의 수출 호조가 지속되고 있고, 기업실적 전망 상향, 경상수지 흑자 확대 등 우리 경제의 펀더멘털(기초 여건)은 여전히 견조하다”며 “우리 증시 전망에 대한 지나친 불안심리 확산에 유의할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

However, the attendees stated, "Given that our stock market has shown greater volatility recently compared to other countries or past periods, we will thoroughly analyze the factors amplifying volatility while maintaining the highest level of vigilance and continuing to operate a 24-hour monitoring system for the time being." They also noted, "We share concerns that the concentration on single-stock leverage products is exacerbating stock market volatility. We will respond swiftly and decisively with a sense of responsibility." (다만 참석자들은 “우리 증시가 최근 다른 나라나 과거에 비해 큰 폭의 변동성을 보이고 있는 만큼, 변동성 증폭 요인을 철저히 분석하는 한편 당분간 최고 수준의 경계감을 가지고 24시간 모니터링 체계를 지속 가동해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다. 또 “단일종목 레버리지 상품으로 인한 쏠림이 증시 변동성을 확대시키고 있다는 우려에 대해 공감한다”며 “책임감을 가지고 신속·과감하게 대응하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-ju kyj@hani.co.kr (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hanyang University ERICA and Kakao Join Hands for Third Year to Address Local Issues (한양대 ERICA·카카오, 지역 현안 해결 위해 3년째 맞손)
item.description:
Hanyang University ERICA (President Lee Ki-jeong) operated the ‘Kakao Ansan Impact Challenge with ERICA IC-PBL’ camp from July 21 to 24 at Kakao's data center in Ansan. (한양대학교 ERICA(총장 이기정)가 7월 21일부터 24일까지 카카오 데이터센터 안산에서 ‘카카오 안산 임팩트 챌린지 with ERICA IC-PBL’ 캠프를 운영했다.)

Now in its third year, this camp is organized by Hanyang University ERICA’s IC-PBL Teaching and Learning Center and collaboratively conducted with Kakao Corporation and Ansan City to identify and seek solutions for local community issues. By integrating Industry-Coupled Problem-Based Learning (IC-PBL) and design thinking-based educational methods, the program supports students in exploring local challenges and proposing feasible solutions. (올해로 3회째를 맞은 이번 캠프는 한양대학교 ERICA IC-PBL교수학습센터가 주관하고, ㈜카카오, 안산시가 협력해 지역사회 문제를 발굴하고 해결 방안을 모색하는 프로젝트다. 산업연계 문제해결학습(Industry-Coupled Problem Based Learning, IC-PBL)과 디자인씽킹(design thinking) 기반의 교육 방식을 접목해 학생들이 지역 현안을 탐색하고 실현 가능한 해결 방안을 제안하도록 지원한다.)

This year’s camp has been extended from the previous two-night, three-day format to three nights and four days. Rather than focusing on deriving solutions within a short period, the program was structured to allow students to examine local phenomena from diverse angles and thoroughly explore issues from the perspectives of various stakeholders. (올해 캠프는 기존 2박 3일에서 3박 4일로 운영 기간을 확대했다. 단기간에 해결안을 도출하는 데 집중하기보다 학생들이 지역의 현상을 다각도로 살펴보고, 다양한 이해관계자의 관점에서 문제를 충분히 탐색할 수 있도록 프로그램을 구성했다.)

Forty Hanyang University ERICA students, selected through document and interview evaluations, participated in the camp. Divided into 10 teams, the students explored and concretized solutions for various local issues in Ansan, including △ education and social integration of multicultural children △ supporting the elderly during post-retirement income gaps △ youth outflow △ revitalizing tourism in Ansan △ supporting international students △ and revitalizing the multicultural village special district. (캠프에는 서류 및 면접 심사를 거쳐 최종 선발된 한양대 ERICA 재학생 40명이 참여했다. 학생들은 10개 팀으로 나뉘어 △다문화 아동의 교육과 사회통합 △은퇴 후 소득 공백기 노년층 지원 △청년 유출 문제 △안산 관광 활성화 △외국인 유학생 지원 △다문화마을특구 활성화 등 안산의 다양한 지역 현안을 탐색하고 해결 아이디어를 구체화했다.)

During the camp, students interviewed Ansan City officials to hear firsthand the voices of the local field and understand the realities of policies and administration. Based on this, they re-examined previously defined problems and refined and developed their team ideas. (학생들은 캠프 기간 안산시 공무원과의 인터뷰를 통해 지역 현장의 목소리를 직접 듣고 정책과 행정의 현실을 이해했다. 이를 바탕으로 기존에 설정한 문제를 다시 살펴보고 팀별 아이디어를 보완·발전시켰다.)

Kakao’s Performance Leader, Lee Jae-seung, stated, “This program is a meaningful industry-academia collaboration model where Kakao, Hanyang University ERICA, and Ansan City join forces to address local issues and foster future young talent. We will continue to provide strong support so that young people can grow into practical professionals by directly participating in solving community problems.” (카카오 이재승 성과리더는 “이번 프로그램은 카카오와 한양대 ERICA, 안산시가 힘을 모아 지역 현안을 해결하고 미래 청년 인재를 양성하는 뜻깊은 산학협력 모델”이라며 “청년들이 지역사회 문제 해결에 직접 참여하며 실무형 인재로 성장할 수 있도록 지원을 아끼지 않겠다”고 밝혔다.)

This project will be operated in connection with the 2026 second-semester liberal arts course ‘Impact Challenge Studio.’ Students are expected to advance the local issues discovered at the camp and implement actual solutions. Teams will be evaluated based on the comprehensive outcomes of the camp and the course, with the top teams receiving the Ansan City Mayor’s Award and the Hanyang University President’s Award. (이번 프로젝트는 2026학년도 2학기 교양과목인 ‘임팩트챌린지스튜디오’와 연계해 운영된다. 학생들은 캠프에서 발굴한 지역 문제를 발전시켜 실제 해결 방안을 실행할 예정이다. 캠프와 수업의 운영 성과를 종합적으로 평가해 우수팀에는 안산시장상과 한양대학교 총장상을 수여한다.)

item.title: Samsung Electronics’ Q2 Semiconductor Operating Profit Reaches 89 Trillion Won… Finished Goods Post First-Ever Deficit (삼성전자 2분기 반도체 영업이익 89조…완제품은 첫 적자)
item.description:
Samsung Electronics recorded an all-time high operating profit of 89.2 trillion won in its semiconductor business division for the second quarter of this year (April to June). This accounted for 99% of the company’s total operating profit. The strong price surge due to memory supply shortages drove performance in the second quarter as well, with the semiconductor operating profit margin climbing to 70%. (삼성전자의 올해 2분기(4∼6월) 반도체 사업 부문 영업이익이 89조2천억원으로 역대 최대를 기록했다. 전사 영업이익의 99%를 반도체 사업에서 벌어들인 것이다. 메모리 공급 부족에 따른 가격 초강세 현상이 2분기에도 실적을 견인한 것으로, 반도체 영업이익률은 70%까지 올라섰다.)

Samsung Electronics announced on the 30th that its second-quarter operating profit stood at 89.5 trillion won, a 1,813% increase compared to the same period last year. Second-quarter revenue reached 171.5 trillion won, up 130% year-on-year. Net profit also rose to 71.6245 trillion won, a 1,299% increase from the same period last year. The company explained, “Amid strong market demand for memory, DRAM and NAND flash achieved record sales based on product competitiveness, breaking the previous quarterly record set in the first quarter.” (삼성전자는 올해 2분기 영업이익이 89조5천억원으로 지난해 같은 분기에 견줘 1813% 늘었다고 30일 공시했다. 2분기 매출액은 171조5천억원으로 전년 동기 대비 130% 늘었다. 당기 순이익도 71조6245억원으로 전년 동기보다 1299% 증가했다. 회사 쪽은 “(메모리) 시장 수요 강세 속 제품 경쟁력을 기반으로 디램과 낸드플래시가 최대 판매를 기록하며 1분기에 이어 역대 최대 분기 실적을 경신했다”고 설명했다.)

By business division, the semiconductor (DS) division posted an operating profit of 89.2 trillion won, accounting for 99.6% of total operating profit. Samsung Electronics’ semiconductor operating profit, which was 350.2 billion won in the second quarter of last year, rose to 6.9913 trillion won in the third quarter, 16.4111 trillion won in the fourth quarter, and surged to 53.7 trillion won in the first quarter of this year. In the second quarter of this year, profit increased by 66.11% compared to the previous quarter, continuing its upward trend. The explosive growth in AI demand led to memory supply shortages, driving up memory prices and boosting operating profit. (사업 부문별로는 반도체(DS) 부문 영업이익이 89조2천억원으로, 전체 영업이익의 99.6%를 차지했다. 삼성전자의 반도체 부문 영업이익은 지난해 2분기 3502억원이었다가 3분기 6조9913억원, 4분기 16조4111억원을 기록한 뒤 올해 1분기에 53조7천억원으로 급증했다. 올해 2분기에도 직전 분기 대비 이익이 66.11% 증가하며 상승세를 이어갔다. 인공지능 수요가 폭증하면서 메모리 공급 부족 사태에 따른 메모리 가격 상승이 영업이익을 끌어올린 것이다.)

The operating profit margin for the semiconductor business in the second quarter also reached 70%. This means that selling a memory chip worth 10,000 won generated a margin of 7,000 won, surpassing the second-quarter operating profit margin of Taiwan’s TSMC (60.3%), which boasts overwhelming profitability. However, it fell short of SK Hynix’s second-quarter operating profit margin (76%). The company stated, “We actively responded to demand for memory and AI servers, achieving another record-breaking performance,” and predicted, “The supply shortage is expected to persist due to accelerating demand growth for DRAM, enterprise SSDs, and high-bandwidth memory (HBM).” (2분기 반도체 사업의 매출액 대비 영업이익 비율(영업이익률)도 70%를 기록했다. 10만원짜리 메모리 칩을 팔면 7만원의 마진을 남겼다는 의미로, 압도적인 수익성을 자랑하는 대만 티에스엠시(TSMC)의 올해 2분기 영업이익률(60.3%)을 넘어서는 것이다. 다만 에스케이(SK)하이닉스의 2분기 영업이익률(76%)에는 미치지 못했다. 회사 쪽은 “메모리, 인공지능(AI) 서버 수요에 적극 대응해 역대 최대 실적을 재경신했다”며 “디램, 기업용 SSD, 고대역폭메모리(HBM) 수요 성장 가속화로 인해 공급 부족 현상은 지속될 전망”이라고 내다봤다.)

In the second quarter, the finished goods (DX) business division, which includes smartphones, TVs, and home appliances, recorded an operating loss of 800 billion won. Although solid sales of the Galaxy S-26 and A series generated revenue of 48 trillion won, rising component costs led to increased expense burdens, resulting in the first-ever quarterly deficit. The display and Harman (automotive electronics) divisions posted operating profits of 700 billion won and 400 billion won, respectively. Samsung Electronics stated, “Strong semiconductor demand is expected to continue in the second half, driving overall company growth,” adding, “The semiconductor division is expected to maintain its upward trend due to strong demand from the spread of agentic AI, but the finished goods division is anticipated to face a difficult business environment due to rising component costs, so we plan to simultaneously pursue business competitiveness enhancement and structural improvement.” (2분기 스마트폰·티브이(TV)·생활가전 등 완제품(DX) 사업 부문은 영업손실 8천억원의 적자를 기록했다. 갤럭시 S-26과 A시리즈의 견조한 판매로 매출은 48조원을 기록했지만, 부품 원가 상승에 따른 비용 부담 확대로 사상 첫 분기 적자를 기록했다. 디스플레이와 하만(전장 사업) 부문 영업이익은 각각 7천억원, 4천억원으로 집계됐다. 삼성전자는 “하반기에도 반도체 수요 강세가 이어지며 전사 실적은 성장할 것으로 전망된다”며 “반도체 부문은 에이전틱 에이아이 확산에 따른 수요 강세로 실적 상승세가 지속될 것으로 예상되지만, 완제품 부문은 부품 비용 상승 등으로 어려운 경영환경이 지속될 것으로 예상돼 사업 경쟁력 강화와 체질 개선을 함께 추진할 방침”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Bae Ji-hyun beep@hani.co.kr (배지현 기자 beep@hani.co.kr)

item.title: After Two Days of Plunge, Market Catching Its Breath… KOSPI and KOSDAQ Fluctuate Repeatedly (이틀 폭락 뒤 숨고르나…코스피·코스닥 등락 거듭)
item.description:
Domestic stock prices, which had been on a two-day plunge, are showing extreme volatility on the morning of the 30th, fluctuating between gains and losses. (연이틀 폭락세를 기록한 국내 주가가 30일 오전 장에서는 등락을 거듭하며 극심한 혼조세를 나타내고 있다.)

On this day, the KOSPI index opened at 5681.77, up 18.53 points (0.33%) from the previous day, and has been alternating between declines and advances. As of 9:15 a.m., the KOSPI is trading at 5723.65, up 1.07% from the previous day. Samsung Electronics, which announced its second-quarter earnings today, started with a slight uptick and has expanded its gains, now trading over 2% higher. SK Hynix, continuing from the previous day, has fallen sharply, recording a decline rate of around 4%. (이날 코스피지수는 전날보다 18.53(0.33%) 오른 5681.77로 출발했다가 하락과 상승을 거듭하고 있다. 코스피는 9시15분 현재 전날보다 1.07% 오른 5723.65를 기록하고 있다. 이날 2분기 실적을 발표한 삼성전자 주가는 소폭의 오름세로 출발해 상승 폭을 키워 2% 넘게 오른 상태로 거래되고 있다. 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 전날에 이어 큰 폭으로 떨어져 4%대의 하락률을 기록 중이다.)

The KOSDAQ index began at 654.72, down 7.96 points (1.20%), and after fluctuating, as of 9:15 a.m., it is at 673.79, up 1.68%. (코스닥지수는 7.96(1.20%) 내린 654.72로 시작한 뒤 등락하다 9시15분 현재 1.68% 오른 673.79를 보이고 있다.)

item.title: Government Says "Policy Rate Path Uncertainty Persists" After Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady (연준 기준금리 동결에 정부 “정책금리 경로 불확실성 지속”)
item.description:
Shortly after the U.S. Federal Reserve decided to keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged, the Korean government assessed that uncertainty surrounding the policy rate path of major countries could persist. (미국 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)의 기준금리 동결 결정 직후 정부는 향후 주요국의 정책금리 경로를 둘러싼 불확실성이 지속될 수 있다고 평가했다.)

On the morning of the 30th, First Vice Minister of Economy and Finance Lee Hyung-il convened a joint macroeconomic and financial meeting with relevant agencies at the Korea Federation of Banks in Jung-gu, Seoul, to review global financial market trends following the Federal Open Market Committee's interest rate hold decision and the impact of the Middle East conflict on financial and foreign exchange markets. Deputy Governor of the Bank of Korea Yoo Sang-dae, Vice Chairman of the Financial Services Commission Kwon Dae-young, and Deputy Governor for Capital Markets at the Financial Supervisory Service Hwang Sun-oh attended the meeting. (이형일 재정경제부 1차관은 30일 오전 서울 중구 전국은행연합회관에서 관계기관 합동 거시경제금융회의를 열고, 미국 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)의 금리 동결 결정에 따른 글로벌 금융시장 동향과 중동전쟁에 따른 금융·외환시장 동향을 점검했다. 유상대 한국은행 부총재와 권대영 금융위원회 부위원장, 황선오 금융감독원 자본시장부원장이 회의에 참석했다.)

Participants noted that while the Fed kept rates steady, the U.S. economy remains robust, with strong growth in corporate facility investments, especially those related to artificial intelligence. However, they assessed that "inflation in the U.S. and Europe remains high, and the ongoing instability in the Middle East could sustain uncertainty over the future policy rate path." (참석자들은 연준이 기준금리를 동결한 가운데 미국 경제가 견조한 흐름을 이어가고 인공지능(AI) 관련 투자를 중심으로 기업들의 설비투자도 강한 성장세를 지속하고 있다는 점에 주목했다. 다만 “미국과 유럽 등의 물가가 여전히 높은 수준을 보이고, 중동 정세 불안도 이어지고 있어 향후 정책금리 경로의 불확실성이 지속될 수 있다”고 평가했다.)

The government and relevant agencies agreed to closely monitor external conditions, including monetary policies of major countries, international oil prices, and global capital flows, while meticulously assessing their impact on international financial market trends and the domestic economy and financial markets. (정부와 관계기관은 앞으로 주요국 통화정책과 국제유가, 글로벌 자금 흐름 등 대외 여건을 주시하면서 국제금융시장 동향과 국내 경제·금융시장에 미치는 영향을 면밀히 점검해 나가기로 했다.)

By Park Soo-ji, Reporter suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Professor Park Yong-cheol of Kookmin University Selected for the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy's Bio Industry Technology Development Project Overall Task (국민대 박용철 교수, 산업통상부 바이오산업기술개발사업 총괄과제 선정)
item.description:
A research team led by Professor Park Yong-cheol from the Department of Convergence Bioengineering at Kookmin University (President Jeong Seung-ryeol) has been ultimately selected as a new funding recipient for the 'Bio Industry Technology Development' detailed project under the '1st Bio-Health Sector Research and Development Project for 2026,' which is organized by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE) and supported by the Korea Planning & Evaluation Institute of Industrial Technology (KEIT). (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) 융합바이오공학과 박용철 교수 연구팀이 산업통상부가 주관하고 한국산업기술기획평가원(KEIT)이 지원하는 ‘2026년도 제1차 바이오헬스 분야 연구개발사업’의 ‘바이오산업기술개발’ 세부사업의 신규 지원 사업자로 최종 선정됐다.)

Kookmin University will serve as the lead institution for the overall task in the 'Advanced Bio-New Materials' sector. The project aims to establish a support system for the manufacturing and commercialization of high-value-added and highly functional biomaterials based on ultra-fast microbial processes, and will run until 2030. (국민대는 ‘첨단바이오신소재’ 분야 총괄과제의 주관기관을 맡는다. 과제는 ‘초고속 미생물 공정 기반 고부가가치 및 고기능성 바이오소재 제조 및 제품화 지원체계 구축’을 목표로 2030년까지 진행된다.)

Advanced bio-new materials refer to materials that utilize living organisms, nature-derived raw materials, or bioprocessing technologies for application in related industries such as medical, chemical, food, and cosmetics. In this project, technologies for mass production processes and product commercialization will be developed targeting microbe-derived exosomes, high-purity vitamins, and microbial lutein. (첨단바이오신소재는 생물체와 자연 유래 원료 또는 바이오공정 기술을 활용해 의료·화학·식품·화장품 등 관련 산업에 적용할 수 있는 소재를 의미한다. 이번 사업에서는 미생물 유래 엑소좀, 고순도 비타민, 미생물 루테인을 대상으로 대량생산 공정과 제품화 기술을 개발한다.)

This project comprises one overall task led by Kookmin University and three detailed tasks, with a total of 17 companies and institutions participating. The entire project scale, including the overall task and detailed tasks, amounts to a total of 22.2 billion won, comprising 15.9 billion won in government grants and 6.3 billion won in institutional support. (이번 사업은 국민대가 주관하는 1개의 총괄과제와 3개의 세부과제로 구성되며, 총 17개 기업과 기관이 참여한다. 총괄과제와 세부과제를 포함한 사업 전체 규모는 정부출연금 159억 원과 기관지원금 63억 원 등 총 222억 원이다.)

The first detailed task is the 'Development of Bio-production Process and Commercialization Technology for Multi-functional Beauty Materials Based on Microbe-Derived Exosomes,' led by BioFD&C Co., Ltd. The second task will be conducted by Ace Biofarm Co., Ltd., focusing on 'Development of Mass Production and High-Function Product Commercialization Technology for High-Purity Vitamins Based on Microbial Processes.' Daebong LS Co., Ltd. will lead the third task, 'Development of Bio-manufacturing Process and Material Commercialization Technology for Industrial Microbe-Based Lutein Mass Production.' (첫 번째 세부과제는 ㈜바이오에프디엔씨가 주관하는 ‘미생물 유래 엑소좀 기반 다기능성 뷰티소재의 바이오 생산공정 및 제품화 기술 개발’이다. 두 번째 과제는 에이스바이오팜㈜이 ‘미생물 공정 기반 고순도 비타민의 대량생산 및 고기능 제품화 기술 개발’을 수행한다. 대봉엘에스㈜는 세 번째 과제인 ‘산업용 미생물 기반 루테인 대량생산 생물제조공정 및 소재 상용화 기술 개발’을 주관한다.)

The research team plans to develop ultra-fast microbial design technologies based on synthetic biology and biofoundries, as well as fermentation and purification processes based on precision fermentation, and bio-manufacturing process technologies utilizing big data and deep learning. This will lay the groundwork for the mass production of high-value-added and highly functional biomaterials that exist only in small quantities in natural products, and establish a support system linking production processes to product commercialization. (연구진은 합성생물학과 바이오파운드리 기반의 초고속 미생물 설계 기술을 비롯해 정밀발효 기반 발효·정제 공정, 빅데이터와 딥러닝을 활용한 바이오 제조공정 기술을 개발할 예정이다. 이를 통해 천연물에 소량 존재하는 고부가가치 및 고기능성 바이오소재의 대량생산 기반을 마련하고, 생산공정부터 제품화까지 연계하는 지원 체계를 구축한다.)

Professor Park Yong-cheol of Kookmin University, the overall task leader, stated, "This project is a large-scale research and development task involving 17 companies and institutions, linking the production of highly functional biomaterials to their commercialization," and added, "We will develop technologies that support the mass production and industrialization of advanced bio-new materials based on synthetic biology, biofoundries, and precision fermentation technologies." (총괄과제 책임자인 박용철 국민대 교수는 “이번 사업은 17개 기업과 기관이 참여해 고기능성 바이오소재의 생산부터 제품화까지 연계하는 대형 연구개발 과제”라며 “합성생물학, 바이오파운드리, 정밀발효 기술을 기반으로 첨단바이오신소재의 대량생산과 산업화를 지원할 수 있는 기술을 개발하겠다”고 밝혔다.)
